verdict.rationale: DBOS documents workflow code versioning/patching strategies for safe upgrades and publishes a versioned OpenAPI 3.1 spec for its Conductor control-plane API, but there is no evidence of a documented deprecation policy for DBOS's own SDK/CLI/API surface (e.g., version support windows, breaking-change notices, sunset timelines). Missing for 10: an explicit deprecation policy document, semantic versioning guarantees for the library/CLI/API, and any changelog or migration-notice process for deprecated features.
